features.ledgerBody: Posted entries are never edited. Corrections are reversals, so the audit trail stays complete.
features.tenantBody: Row-level security in the database keeps every somiti's data separate.
features.bilingualBody: Lakh and crore grouping, Bangla digits and Dhaka dates throughout.

opening.title: Bring in your old books
opening.subtitle: Start every member with the shares and savings they already have, in one go.

steps.downloadBody: It opens in Excel, with a column for each of your {count, plural, one {# savings product} other {# savings products}}.
steps.fill: Fill in one row per member
steps.fillBody: Name, mobile number, shares held and each savings balance as it stands in your register today.
steps.uploadBody: Save as CSV and upload it. You see every total and problem first; nothing is posted until you confirm.

guide.title: What goes in each column
guide.name_en: Name in English. One of the two names is enough.
guide.phone: Mobile number. A missing leading 0 is fine.
guide.admission_date: When they joined, day first. Blank means today.
guide.shares: Shares held, at {price} each. Blank means none.
guide.product: Balance in {name}. Blank opens no account; 0 opens an empty one.
